captions.detailed: A wall-mounted task lamp consisting of a black rectangular wall bracket, a grey folding scissor-style arm with two articulated segments, and a cylindrical black lamp shade at the end. The two segments of the arm fold via revolute joints, and the cylindrical shade rotates at its connection point to direct light.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wall-mounted task lamp. The design should feature a rectangular wall plate, a dual-segment folding arm with revolute joints, and a rotating cylindrical lamp head at the tip, utilizing black and grey materials.
captions.factory: Construct a rectangular base plate using a box primitive with cylindrical screw holes subtracted. Build the folding arm segments using boxes for the side rails and cylinders for the crossbars and joint hinges. Assemble the lamp head by combining a hollowed-out cylinder for the shade with a small sphere inside representing the bulb, and link all parts sequentially with revolute articulations.
